keep.text: Sab bolte hain ki peptides kha lo, peptides laga lo, but koi ye nahi batata hai ki kaun si peptides achhi hain, kaun si peptides kharab hain aapke liye,
kaun si FDA approved hai, kaun si nahi hai.
Log BPC-157, Ozempic, Sermorelin ko ek hi basket mein daal dete hain,
aap logon ko main ye bata deta hoon, peptides alag alag cheezon ke liye bani hui hain.
Sabka alag evidence hai aur sabka alag risk hai.
Sab log isko overcomplicate kar dete hain. Sabse simple version main aaj ki video mein bataunga,
aur inke phase 3 trials ho chuke hain, FDA approved hain,
aur millions of patients ke upar
lag chuka hai unko, toh ye proven bhi hai. Toh isko main 5 star doonga.
Kyun? Kyunki ye FDA approved hai.
ye sab growth hormone badhaane waale peptides hain.
Tesamorelin FDA approved hai ek condition ke liye, baaki research level par chal rahi hai, aur
In saare peptides mein Instagram pe sabse popular jo hai, wo yahi saari peptides hain. 100 plus animals ke upar studies hui hain, insaanon pe sirf 2-3 chhoti
Jitne log bata rahe hain ki BPC-157 achhi hai, TB-500 achhi hai, Wolverine stack achha hai, toh in saare logon ko main bata raha hoon, ye saare ke saare
abhi sahi tareeke se proven bhi nahi hain.

Toh aap logon ko irony samajh mein aayi? Jo sabse popular hai Instagram pe, uska koi evidence nahi, aur jo actually proven hai, uske baare mein log baat nahi karna chahte hain. Kyun? Kyunki wo boring hai.
Aur sabse important cheez, jo sabse zyada proven hai,
ki fasting, diet, exercise, meditation, ab is par kyun koi baat kare? Kyun?
Fasting free hai, diet free hai, exercise free hai, meditation free hai. Ye saari cheezein kaun karna chahta hai? Maine 110 kilo se 85 kilo tak,
poora ka poora wajan ghataya hai,
Kisi bhi category mein aap mujhe dhakel dena:
achhi fasting ke liye, achhi exercise ke liye, wo saari cheezein maine ki hain.
phir decide kariye. Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain
